title: European Defence & UAV Investor Research
scope: EU27 + UK, Norway, Switzerland, Ukraine, Türkiye; external US capital appendix

methodology.unit: One investor/manager/platform record; vehicles nested or named in notes, not counted as independent managers.
methodology.coverage: Broad public-source landscape, not a claim of an exhaustive investor universe. Uneven disclosure and unpublished deals leave gaps.
methodology.verification: Deal = public portfolio/transaction evidence. Mandate = explicit investment strategy, not proof of current deployment. Adjacent = relevant ecosystem relationship, not confirmed defence specialist.
methodology.location: Country associations are an index, not HQ or eligibility. Published office/contact cities alone populate map candidates; coordinates approximate city centres.
methodology.unknowns: Null/empty values mean not established, never zero. Fund-size totals deliberately omitted because targets, commitments and AUM are not comparable.
methodology.publication: Research staging only; website/database not modified. Map-ready means minimum evidence for a city-level candidate, not completed editorial approval.
methodology.limits: Not every linked page has been fully read; evidence includes retrieved primary-source passages. No paid registries, direct fund confirmations or private deals. Review dates are retrieval dates, not transaction dates.
